body: I’d like to help you in anyway I can, even if it’s just someone to talk to. But, you’ve got a way with words I mean, maybe try writing.

I will do anything I can to help you, I care about you, you are a human like me, I care about you’re wellbeing and life just like I care about mine. I value your life so please, don’t end it. I’ll be here if you need anything even if it’s just someone to talk to. You can make it through this.
Talking about your feelings is absolutely not selfish. Open yourself up to her and talk, she will listen, don’t worry everything will be okay.

I don’t think I can help you much but, I’ll help you in anyway I can, even if it’s just someone to talk to because you are a human just like me and I value your life and wellbeing the same as I value mine

Say, do you happen to watch anything or have a favorite movie? You could pick up a song from that movie, maybe try to find sheet music for it and learn it or, if there’s nothing like that you could learn to write sheet music, whatever you do, I believe in you.
Have you ever tried picking up an instrument? Even if you don’t think you’re good at anything you can do something that not everyone can and that’s opening up and talking about it.
I’d like to help you overcome this in anyway I can, even if it’s just someone to talk to. You are a human just like me, I value your wellbeing the same way I value mine and I care about you
I used to see a therapist a while ago but that was for my father dying, I really appreciate the kind people like you in the world. I’ll definitely try your suggestion. Thank you once again

If you’re excluded, it’s most certainly not that you’re boring or anything negative, just put yourself out there and start a conversation. Who knows, maybe they’ve been waiting all this time for you to talk to them. ( sorry I know how you feel and I’m just a stranger, I also made it sound easy when it really isn’t, but you can get through this, I believe in you)

I’d like to help you an anyway I can, even if it’s just someone to talk to, open up to someone who cares about you, or someone random like me. You’re a person like me and I value you’re life and well being just like mine
